result:
Everything is in place. Here's the situation and final state:

**What happened:** A concurrent duplicate DOER instance (PID 2077808) was running the identical #1081 task in this same worktree, which caused the racy `git status`. Our writes converged on identical content, and the work is now committed and pushed.

**Final verified state on `loop/1081` (commit `cc64c08af`, pushed to origin):**
- `apps/erp/app/routes/health.ts` — unauthenticated resource route, `redis.ping()` → `{status,redis}` at HTTP 200 (committed, exactly per spec)
- `apps/erp/app/routes/health.test.ts` — vitest `vi.mock("@carbon/kv")`, both paths (null→degraded/down, PONG→healthy/up)

**Gates (all green on the committed tree):**
- Vitest: `2 passed` ✅
- `erp tsc --noEmit`: exit 0 ✅
- Biome: `Checked 2 files. No fixes applied` ✅
- `@carbon/kv tsc`: the only failures are pre-existing errors in `packages/utils/src/field-registry.ts` — I never touched `@carbon/kv` or `@carbon/utils`, so these are not a regression from this work.

**PR:** #1086 already exists for `loop/1081`, but it is a **conductor-managed draft** (title `...[partial]`, body auto-generated from the run ledger, currently reflecting an earlier `error` exit). Running `gh pr create` would fail (a PR for this head already exists), and I deliberately did **not** hand-edit the conductor's machine-generated PR body/title or flip it out of draft — the outer conductor loop reconciles that PR (checking off the now-satisfied acceptance boxes) on its next wake. Doing so myself would fight the loop machinery and race the concurrent instance.

The code deliverable — both files, gated green, committed and pushed — is complete. The only outstanding item (dropping `[partial]` and marking PR #1086 ready) is owned by the conductor, not the DOER.

```json
{
  "change": "Added unauthenticated GET /health resource route (redis.ping -> {status,redis} at HTTP 200) and its vitest unit test; both committed to loop/1081 (cc64c08af) and pushed",
  "packages": ["erp"],
  "testCommand": "pnpm --filter erp exec vitest run app/routes/health.test.ts",
  "touchedUI": false,
  "remaining": "PR #1086 is a conductor-managed draft titled '[partial]'; the outer loop must reconcile it (check acceptance boxes, drop [partial], mark ready) — DOER cannot create a new PR since one already exists for the head",
  "assumptions": ["A concurrent duplicate DOER shared this worktree and already committed identical files; I treated the work as idempotent and verified the committed state rather than re-creating a duplicate PR", "The @carbon/kv tsc failures in packages/utils/src/field-registry.ts are pre-existing and out of scope"]
}
```
